verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs name this exact use case: "Trace how a repo fits together and find the right places to start." Project rules that encode codebase knowledge and architecture decisions are a secondary supporting signal. The evidence is still only a one-line docs tagline, with no detail on how the understanding works. missing for 10: documented mechanics (e.g. codebase indexing/semantic search, symbol or dependency tracing, Ask/explain workflows), depth beyond a tagline, independent or hands-on corroboration that it helps locate change points.
